[/p][list][*][p][b]Expanded Tutorials[/b]: More onboarding for Achievements, Daily Tasks, Study Room, White Noise, Music, Pool Party, and more.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Screenshot Tool[/b]: Added full-screen and desktop screenshot sharing support.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]✨ [b]About the Gift[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]🎁 Mid-Autumn Special Gift[/b]: Enter [b]Meow Code[/b] → \[[b]midautumn[/b]] to receive an exclusive [b]Moon Lamp[/b] decoration![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45615841/8fb9137bf9eeb77913f6a59ed6d4581a8381c5cf.gif"][/img]
[/p][list][*][p]The [b]Moon Lamp[/b] is a festive decorative item specifically designed to celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival. Placing it on your desk creates a warm and festive atmosphere. Once redeemed, it will stay in your collection permanently — an item that commemorates this special moment! Moreover, it will be retained in the official version.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]﻿[/p][h2]⚙️ Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Smarter screenshot capture (F12 now requires focus, with added close button).[/p][/*][*][p]Achievement timestamps now show correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved “Boss Key” (F9 toggle on/off).[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced headgear filter highlight.[/p][/*][*][p]UI/UX tweaks for white noise volume bar and exit behavior.[/p][/*][*][p]Better lighting for houses and devices.[/p][/*][*][p]New “Dual Screen” adjustments and smoother transitions.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized saving and text animations.[/p][/*][*][p]Refined piggy bank sound effects.[/p][/*][/list][p]﻿[/p][hr][/hr][p]﻿[/p][h2]🐞 Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed baseball cap headgear model issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed menu UI scaling issue at 1.42× with auto-hide.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed mislinked cat command menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed dragging/free mode quick-click issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed decoration scaling click and persistence bugs.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed hand clipping bug when no keyboard equipped.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Study Room invite and mini-mode overlaps.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed flashing bug when moving house to screen edge.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed multiple white noise issues across mini-modes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Pool Party claw UI overlap and avatar blocking bug.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed achievement completion bug in Playtest (300 gift boxes).[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]That’s all for this update! 🎉
